title: Commission Regulation (EU) No 1129/2011 of 11 November 2011 amending Annex II to Regulation (EC) No 1333/2008 of the European Parliament and of the Council by establishing a Union list of food additives
journal: Official Journal of the European Union, L 295, 12 November 2011, p. 1
result: Annex II, Part C, Group I lists E 500 sodium carbonates with the specific maximum level quantum satis. E 500 is also listed at quantum satis in individual food categories, including soured cream butter and salt, and 'only as rising agent' in processed cereal-based foods and baby foods for infants and young children.
